why: I know this horse and never noticed it stands on one foot, and 'one bird carries 7 kg of bronze' made me want the answer. But it is a statement, not a question. The real hook (title card at 9 s, 'what bird is it actually?') comes after my 3-second decision, so I am held by the picture plus mild curiosity.
first_moment_I_got_curious: Line 2 (4.6 s) '全压在一只鸟的背上', then 9.0 s title card. Strongest early spike: line 6 (22.4 s) 两匹耕马刚死 / 39匹铜马.
where_I_would_swipe_away: 75-85 s (lines 18-21): timeline of 郭沫若 / Paris / London / 十几个国家 / 1983 logo. Dates and places with no tension, and I forget the bird question asked at 9 s.
31-36 s (lines 7-8): 党寿山 name drop and 'national relics cannot be sold' slogan. Mild dip.
62-71 s (lines 16-17): 对侧步 / 河西 / 走马 after the funny 顺拐. Lecture voice.
125-134 s (lines 29-31): 龙雀 / 张衡《东京赋》/ 牛龙菲 / 马超龙雀. Four proper nouns in 9 seconds.
lines_I_did_not_understand: 19: who actually named it 马踏飞燕? 郭沫若 said 天马行空, but I can't tell how that became the name.
27: 猎鹰系铃 - I didn't know falconers tie bells on hawks, so the tail dent means nothing until guessed.
26: 鹰隼类猛禽 - 隼 I can't read; skimmed.
29-30: 龙雀 / 风神 - is it a real bird or myth? Why does 龙雀 and 天马 in the same sentence of 《东京赋》 matter?
16-17: 河西 / 对侧步 / 走马 - guessed from context.
38: 说不准的，就先不写进名字 - I can't tell if this is the documented reason or the film's neat spin.
40: 鸟刚回头，马已经冲过去 - probably describes the picture; with words alone I can't follow.
takeaway_in_my_words: The bird under 马踏飞燕 may not be a swallow. Nobody knows what bird it is, so the horse's real name is 铜奔马 and has no bird in it. And an iron skeleton plus the bird's wings are what let it stand on one foot.
surprise_that_stuck: The real name is 铜奔马, with no bird in it, and the expert who named it is the one who thinks the bird is a 猎鹰. Second: X-ray shows iron bones inside the horse's legs (铁骨铜腿).
title_I_would_click: Title card at 9 s: '马踏飞燕，脚下踩的到底是什么鸟？' It is concrete and I can already half-answer it (燕子?), which makes me want to check.
title_that_misleads: The same title promises an answer ('到底是什么鸟') and the film's answer is 'no consensus'. It misleads a little, but the 铜奔马 twist makes up for it.
what_I_would_comment: 我选猎鹰，燕子尾巴是剪刀，这只是平的。 / 所以我们喊了这么多年的名字其实是个没定论的猜测？？
